name: Asset-level KPI reporting commitment

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraph 4.25 — ongoing reporting obligation for labelled products); Chapter 5: Disclosures (consumer-facing, pre-contractual, ongoing)

summary: Tests whether the developer has committed to annual disclosure of asset-level sustainability KPIs material to the data-centre sector. PS23/16 mandates ongoing reporting but does not enumerate sector-specific KPIs; PB methodology v3.5 requires four KPIs (PUE, renewable energy %, GHG Scope 1+2, WUE) as the material set for data centres — these are the same KPIs scored under EU Taxonomy 8.1 substantial contribution + DNSH so the reporting commitment is consistent with the credible-standard claim.
